title: 第10章 他要冲击的，是金丹大道。
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
这简直是为顾长青量身定做的完美身份。

    十年前，真正的淮南王刘安，在一场突如其来的重病中“不治身亡”。

    而顾长青，则用神鬼莫测的手段，悄无声息地取代了他。

    他没有杀人，只是在刘安弥留之际，用一缕神识，读取了他所有的记忆，然后，以类似于“夺舍”，但又温和许多的秘术，占据了这具即将死亡的身体。

    从此，世上再无顾长青，只有淮南王刘安。

    这十年来，他完美地扮演着自己的角色。

    一方面，他继续招揽天下有才之士，编撰书籍，在文人雅士中，获得了极高的声望。

    另一方面，他以“炼制黄白之物，寻求仙道”

    为名，在自己的封地内，大肆搜罗各种奇特的矿石、草药。

    他的行为，在世人看来，不过是一个不务正业，沉迷于虚妄之事的王爷。

    就连远在长安的汉武帝，也只是将他当成一个颇有才华，但无心政事的皇亲国戚，对他颇为放纵。

    没有人知道，这位淮南王，正在利用整个淮南国的资源，为自己冲击金丹大道，做着最后的准备。

    “大王。”

    一名门客走进书房，躬身行礼。

    “长安那边，有消息了吗？”

    顾长青放下竹简，淡淡地问道。

    “回大王，已经打探清楚了。”

    门客恭敬地回答，“陛下最近，确有炼制仙丹之意。方士李少君，正得圣宠。据说，他向陛下进言，说只要祭祀‘灶君’，便可招来神物，以丹砂炼制黄金，再用黄金制成餐具，便可延年益寿，得见蓬莱仙人。”

    顾长青听完，嘴角不由得露出讥讽的笑意。

    又是丹砂。

    又是蓬莱。

    这些方士的骗术，千百年来，还是老一套。

    当年的秦始皇因此而死，如今的汉武帝，又一头栽了进去。

    帝王心性，果然都是一样的。

    不过，这对顾长青来说，却是一个千载难逢的机会。

    汉武帝求仙，天下必然会再次掀起寻找仙草灵药的热潮。

    当年秦始皇没能找到的东西，或许，在这更广阔，更强盛的大汉王朝，能够找到。

    他可以借着这股东风，浑水摸鱼。

    “很好。”

    顾长青点了点头，“你传令下去，让我们在各地的人，都行动起来。”

    “告诉他们，我要的，不是那些虚无缥缈的丹方，也不是那些炼金的方术。”

    “我要的，是真正的，生长于深山大泽，能够吞吐日月精华的‘神草’！”

    他从袖中，再次取出了那几张早已泛黄的图谱。

    上面描绘的，正是他结成金丹所必需的几味主药。

    “将这些图样，想办法，流传出去。就说是上古仙人留下的神药图谱，得一株，便可羽化登仙。”

    “是，大王！”

    门客接过图谱，郑重地退了出去。

    顾长青重新拿起那卷《淮南子》，目光却变得悠远。

    秦始皇的时代，他借助的是整个帝国的行政力量，进行的是一场自上而下的，强制性的搜寻。

    而这一次，他要反其道而行之。

    他要利用人心的贪婪与欲望，发动一场自下而上的，遍布整个民间的寻宝热潮。

    他相信，重赏之下，必有勇夫。

    只要那些灵草真的还存在于这个世界，就一定会被某个幸运儿，从某个不知名的角落里，给翻出来。

    “始皇帝，你以龙魂镇压九州龙脉，断绝了此界的灵气复苏之路。”

    “但你恐怕也想不到，这反而让一些残存的灵根，为了生存，将所有的灵气，都凝聚在了自己身上，从而产生了某种变异，成为了真正的‘神物’。”

    顾长青的神识，能隐约感觉到，在这片被枷锁束缚的土地深处，有那么几点微弱，但却无比精纯的灵气光点，在顽强地闪烁着。

    它们，就是自己的希望。
content_en:
This is simply a perfect identity tailor-made for Gu Changqing.

    Ten years ago, the real Huainan King Liu An "died" of a sudden serious illness.

    Gu Changqing, on the other hand, used unpredictable means to quietly replace him.

    He did not kill anyone, but when Liu An was dying, he used a ray of spiritual consciousness to read all his memories, and then used a secret technique similar to "seizing the body" but much gentler to occupy the body that was about to die.

    From then on, there was no Gu Changqing in the world, only Liu An, the king of Huainan.

    For ten years, he played his role perfectly.

    On the one hand, he continued to recruit talented people from all over the world, compiled books, and gained a high reputation among literati.

    On the other hand, he "refined yellow and white things to seek immortality"

    In order to make a name for himself, he searched for all kinds of strange ores and herbs in his fiefdom.

    In the eyes of the world, his behavior is just that of a prince who does not do his job properly and is addicted to false things.

    Even Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, who was far away in Chang'an, only regarded him as a talented but uninterested imperial relative and indulged him.

    No one knows that this King of Huainan is using the resources of the entire Huainan Kingdom to make final preparations for his attack on the Golden Pill Avenue.

    "Your Majesty."

    A guest walked into the study and bowed.

    "Is there any news from Chang'an?"

    Gu Changqing put down the bamboo slips and asked calmly.

    "Go back to your Majesty, we have already found out everything."

    The retainer replied respectfully, "Your Majesty has recently been interested in refining elixirs. The alchemist Li Shaojun is in favor of the Holy Spirit. It is said that he advised your Majesty that as long as you offer sacrifices to the 'Zao Lord', you can attract divine objects, refine gold with cinnabar, and then use gold to make tableware. You can live longer and meet Penglai Immortal."

    After hearing this, Gu Changqing couldn't help but reveal a sarcastic smile.

    It’s cinnabar again.

    It’s Penglai again.

    The deceptions used by these alchemists have remained the same for thousands of years.

    The first emperor of Qin died because of this, and now Emperor Wu of Han fell into it again.

    The minds of emperors are indeed the same.

    However, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for Gu Changqing.

    When Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty sought immortality, the world would inevitably start a craze for searching for immortality and elixir.

    What Qin Shihuang failed to find back then may be found in the broader and more powerful Han Dynasty.

    He can take advantage of this trend to fish in troubled waters.

    "Very good."

    Gu Changqing nodded, "Send the order and let our people everywhere take action."

    "Tell them, what I want is not those illusory elixir recipes, nor those alchemical recipes."

    "What I want is the real 'divine grass' that grows in the mountains and swamps and can absorb the essence of the sun and the moon!"

    He once again took out the yellowed maps from his sleeves.

    Described above are the main ingredients he needed to form the golden elixir.

    "Find a way to spread these drawings. It is said to be a map of the magical medicine left by the ancient immortals. If you get one, you can become an immortal."

    "Yes, Your Majesty!"

    The doorman took the map and solemnly left.

    Gu Changqing picked up the volume of "Huainanzi" again, but his eyes became distant.

    In the era of Qin Shihuang, he relied on the administrative power of the entire empire to conduct a top-down, mandatory search.

    But this time, he was going to do the opposite.

    He wants to take advantage of people's greed and desire to launch a bottom-up treasure hunt craze that spreads throughout the people.

    He believed that under heavy rewards, there would be brave men.

    As long as those spiritual herbs really exist in this world, they will be dug out by some lucky person from some unknown corner.

    "First Emperor, you used the dragon soul to suppress the dragon veins of the Nine Provinces and cut off the path for the recovery of spiritual energy in this world."

    "But you probably wouldn't have thought that this would cause some of the remaining spiritual roots to condense all the spiritual energy into themselves in order to survive, thus producing some kind of mutation and becoming a real 'divine object'."

    Gu Changqing's consciousness could vaguely feel that deep in the shackles of the land, there were a few weak but extremely pure points of spiritual energy flickering tenaciously.

    They are their own hopes.
title_en: Chapter 10 What he wants to attack is the Golden Elixir Avenue.
